crossRefs.note: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

translations.web: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
translations.bsb: Wisdom is found with the elderly, and understanding comes with long life.
translations.kjv: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
translations.asv: With aged men is wisdom, And in length of days understanding.
